items: Bungalo to paradise is just that. Our newly remodeled 3-bedroom 4 bath home is located in the luxurious Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort. The Bungalo community is family/pet friendly and has its own neighborhood pool with a small putting green just yards from the front screened in porch. The home comes with two golf carts, one six-seater and one four-seater allowing you and your guest easy access to Village of Baytowne Wharf for dining, shopping and entertainment.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
